title: PP1 ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
text:
HOLIDAY ENVIRONMENTAL HOMEWORK – PP1
 1. Answer the following questions orally.
 What is your name?
 What is the name of your teacher?
 What is the name of your school?
 2. Name 3 parts of the body (orally).
 3. Draw the pictures.
 Sun Ball
 4. Match the classroom objects.
 5. Match the weather symbols.
 6. Colour the kitchen utensils.
 Spoon
 Cup Sufuria
 Jug Glass Knife
 7. Colour the picture.
 8. Match parts of the body.
 9. Colour the family members.
 Father Mother
 Brother Sister Baby
 10. Colour the flag.
 11. Join the dots to make a picture.
